Frequently asked questions,
answered
Where do you recommend using technical screening tools in the hiring process?
We recommend using our coding challenges for screening candidates in the early part of the hiring process.
How many coding challenges does Hirevue offer?
We have more than 200 OnDemand coding skills assessments available for in-demand programming languages such as Python, Java, Ruby, Javascript, PHP, C++, Perl and more.
Can candidates complete the Coding Challenges on their own devices?
Yes, candidates complete the coding assessment on their own time, on any device.
What kind of support does Hirevue offer during and after implementation?
Your Hirevue team will be your partner before, during and after implementation to make sure your coding skills assessment is performing as expected and helping you meet your goals. This might include an account team, and candidates and recruiters also have access to 24/7 support.
